long_biography.plain_text:
Supreme Group began with Alfred Orenstein supplying food to American military bases in Germany. His son Stephen assumed responsibility after Alfred's death in 1985 and widened the family company into an international network for food, water, fuel and transport. Work supporting forces in Afghanistan became its defining assignment.

Orenstein also developed a long-standing connection to Eintracht Frankfurt. A season-ticket holder for decades, he invested through Freunde des Adlers and later served on the football company's supervisory board. He stepped down from the board in 2024 but remains an investor in the club.
